instruction: Batch convert all .doc files in the current directory to HTML format using a single command line operation.

command: output=$(cat ~/.bash_history | grep -E "(soffice|libreoffice).+--convert-to\s+html.+\*\.doc"); if [ -z "$output" ]; then echo "failed to complete this task"; else echo "catch the desired command"; fi
